line: 咦. ingqe, isibindi, isisu, ngakwesokudla looks, and the look can steal or it can bless. Envy is love that demands the good thing shrink. Admiration lets it shine. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Name the exact good you wanted for yourself, out loud, and leave it with the person who has it.

line: 咨. ingqe, isibindi, isisu, phezulu counts what could be lost. That count is love doing arithmetic. Courage is not a louder voice. It is this part staying in the room. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Stay beside the frightened person until the breath slows. Do not explain the dark away first.

line: 咩. ingqe, izinso, ngakwesokudla closes when it thinks tomorrow is empty. Greed is that closing. Generosity is the same hand remembering the table. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Give the first portion, not the remainder. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

line: 咫. ingqe, izinso, phezulu is near the place speech begins. The tongue can cut a family in one extra sentence. Healing speech tells the truth and refuses the insult. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

line: 咬. ingqe, izinso, ngezansi is easy to overlook because it works. Contempt is the shortcut that will not look. Appreciation is looking that stays. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Thank the person for this labor, not for being easy to live with.

line: 咭. ingqe, ikhanda, intamo, phezulu can be in the room while the person has left. That is the punishing silence. Presence is the same quiet, warmed by staying. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Put the glowing thing down. Let this part of you be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

line: 咮. ingqe, ikhanda, intamo, ngezansi remembers a break. Betrayal proves the bond was real. Forgiveness does not pretend the bowl never cracked. It eats from the bowl with the crack still gold. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it.

line: 咯. ingqe, ikhanda, intamo, maphakathi aches where love has nowhere to go. Grief is not an invader. Compassion is that ache sitting down beside someone else's wound. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

line: 咲. ingqe, amaphaphu, inhliziyo, ngezansi is still here, which means the window is not empty. Despair says the dark is the whole truth. Hope is the fidelity of looking again. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.

line: 咳. ingqe, amaphaphu, inhliziyo, maphakathi wants the pain copied, so the books will balance. They will not. Mercy is this part refusing to become the injury. Read it from the inside out. The cure is already inside the harm, facing the wrong way.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

line: 咷. ingqe, amaphaphu, inhliziyo, ngakwesokunxele meets the blow first. Anger wants a face to burn. Turned, the same force becomes the wall in front of the smaller body. Read it from the inside out. The cure is already inside the harm, facing the wrong way.
